name: Mark Teixeira
role: Former Major League Baseball player and 2026 Texas congressional candidate
summary: Teixeira campaigns on border enforcement, gun rights, abortion restrictions and patriotic education. He advocates school choice, domestic energy expansion and a smaller federal role.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Rejects public coverage beyond Medicare and Medicaid.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Rejects higher taxes on wealthier taxpayers.

unions-good.rationale: Defends normal player solidarity for full pay, while urging exceptional pandemic compromise.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Praises Texas for allowing businesses to grow without excessive government burdens.

limit-guns.rationale: Explicitly rejects restrictions on gun ownership.

empower-police-military.rationale: Campaigns to back police and strengthen Joint Base San Antonio.

decide-locally.rationale: Would abolish federal education department, devolving control.

traditional-family.rationale: Treats heterosexual marriage as divinely ordained.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Insists legal marriage is exclusively heterosexual.

abortion-legal.rationale: Permits abortion only for maternal life.

more-religion-public.rationale: Presents public service and political renewal as requiring Christian faith.

open-borders.rationale: Demands a secure border and deportation of unauthorized immigrants.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Includes nuclear expansion in energy-dominance agenda.

political-violence-never.rationale: His support for military strikes accepts some political use of armed force.

separate-church-state.rationale: Affirms nonestablishment but insists Christian values guide officeholding.

school-vouchers.rationale: Actively advocates publicly funded parental school choice against the government-school monopoly.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Would unleash Texas oil and gas production.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Defends religiously motivated refusals of service.

patriotic-education.rationale: Demands patriotic American and Texas education.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: His anti-DEI pledge opposes institutional preference programs; detailed admissions and hiring rules are unspecified.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Supports business refusals on religious grounds.

non-intervention.rationale: Supports US strikes on Iran’s nuclear facilities, qualifying earlier restraint rhetoric.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Rejects gender-identity access to sex-segregated spaces.

term-limits.rationale: Explicitly campaigns for congressional term limits.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: His citizen-only election pledge excludes noncitizen voting without distinguishing local contests.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Interprets political assassination and polarization through evil and redemption in Christ.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Endorses striking Iranian nuclear facilities to prevent a perceived future weapons threat.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Defends civilian ownership without gun restrictions.

notes: His earlier environmental work emphasized restoring urban waterways, parks, transit access and affordable housing. That advocacy and recognition of climate concerns do not establish support for drastic government climate measures. His January-primary questionnaire is candidate-supplied evidence, distinct from the website’s ideological rating. Recent support for Iran strikes qualifies restraint rhetoric; ending every alliance or all intervention is not established. Immigration enforcement does not establish a preferred numerical limit on lawful immigration. His service-refusal position concerns religious objections, not every discriminatory ground. The spiritual-struggle answer uses his interview segment, not Clay Travis’s or the host’s comments. Spending cuts and entitlement reform do not establish a welfare-dependency doctrine or legally binding fiscal rules. No policy is borrowed from Trump, Roy, advisers, endorsers or his opponent.
